xref.title: Secret Grunge Album as "Chick"
xref.body: In 1995, while deeply involved in her "Daydream" pop album, Mariah Carey secretly recorded a grunge record, "Someone's Ugly Daughter," under the band name Chick. Feeling exhausted by pop music, she wrote, produced, sang backup vocals, and even directed videos for this project, which is noted for its quality and resemblance to typical 90s female-fronted alternative rock. "she made a grunge record in secret with a band she called Chick. The album was called Someone's Ugly Daughter."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Taylor Hawkins' First Rock and Roll Gig
xref.body: Canadian singer Sass Jordan gave Taylor Hawkins his first "rock and roll check" (paycheck) when he joined her backup band in 1994. Hawkins toured Europe with her, opening for an aerospace band, which was his initial taste of being in a touring rock band. "She gave me my first rock and roll chick. And check... Not chick, check..."
